messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: my docs PR for the SDK snippets failed docs-preview. Failing checks: linkcheck (missing anchor), remark-lint (MD041 header levels), vale (terminology). Pasting CI summary.

ci-bot: docs-preview failed on 2141805555
ci-bot: Issues: linkcheck (1 missing anchor), remark-lint (MD041), vale (prefer "embedding model" over "embedder"), spellcheck (1)

raj: which file and which anchor? I can grab it.

nina: docs/sdk/python/snippets.md, internal link to #getting-started-snippets -> anchor now is #getting-started (I collapsed the section). I'll update links or add an explicit anchor.

maria: for MD041, looks like there is a skipped H1 in the doc tree. We should follow docs hierarchy: top-level guide uses H2 for pages. Change H1 to H2 in that file.

own: vale flagged "embedder" in the examples. Prefer we use "embedding model" in user-facing docs. Small change in this file ok; repo-wide sweep later.

nina: plan: 1) update internal link to #getting-started, 2) change H1 to H2, 3) replace embedder -> embedding model in this doc only, 4) fix typo reported by spellcheck. Will push shortly.

(10 minutes)

nina: pushed fixes and ran local lint: `npm run docs:format && npm run docs:lint` passes locally.

ci-bot: docs-preview started for PR #4812

ci-bot: linkcheck: passed
ci-bot: remark-lint: passed (MD041 resolved)

ci-bot: vale: warning reduced to informational (no fail)
ci-bot: spellcheck: passed

raj: great. Any reason not to merge now? We should avoid the release freeze window starting at 18:00 PT.

own: I'll merge at 17:50 PT after a quick sanity check of the rendered snippets.

maria: created DOCS-549 to handle a repo-wide terminology sweep for "embedder" -> "embedding model".

nina: merged at 2141805680. Thanks for the quick triage!
